Levels.read-research-article: the instructed everyday action 'read-research-article' (whole segment: prompt -> execute -> end click)
Levels.bad_signal_quality_poor: EEG dominated by a shared large artifact (authors' flag); exclude from EEG analyses
Levels.bad_reference_contact_lost: an ear reference (CMS/DRL) lost contact (authors' flag)
Levels.video_redacted: region-limited blur applied by the authors in ego.mp4 for this window
Levels.video_redacted_audio_muted: blur plus muted audio in this window

source.Description: metadata field the row comes from

experience_id.Description: Custom catalog id for recorded experience, not BIDS presented-stimulus stim_id

experience_file.Description: Custom video path relative to stimuli/; not presented-stimulus stim_file

audio_experience_file.Description: Custom audio path relative to stimuli/

common_duration.Description: Usable interval common to EEG/audio/video actual durations
